description: A Perl script for generating and processing package metadata, including functions for version comparison, dependency analysis, and generating package configuration files in various formats (makefile, JSON, CycloneDX SBOM). It also includes command-line interface handling for different output modes.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string into a numeric value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates kernel config overrides based on package info and build config.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a given package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion in dependency check.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relationship between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration strings for package dependencies.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict configuration strings for package conflicts.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Prints a menu configuration for a package category.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Prints package override configuration if any.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates package configuration in Kconfig format.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition into Kconfig syntax.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical OR condition into Kconfig syntax.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependency string with conditional logic based on a condition.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates package makefile dependencies and build rules.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs package source file information.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs package license information.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Outputs a filtered list of version strings.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignment lists.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from a file (not detailed here).

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata from a file (not detailed here).

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Creates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON structure from components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for image packages.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for package manifests.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Handles command-line arguments and dispatches to appropriate functions.
